name: Ca loc nuong trui
summary: Snakehead grilled in the field style and rolled with whatever forest leaves are in season. It shares the table with bò tơ, bánh tráng phơi sương, and muối tôm, and it is a plate of the old Long An half too.
origin: The Tây Ninh countryside, on the border and in the old Long An half.
howToEat: Pull the fish apart and roll it with the seasonal forest leaves.
where: The border countryside and the old Long An half.
seoTitle: Ca loc nuong trui on the Tay Ninh border
seoDescription: Cá lóc nướng trui, field-grilled snakehead rolled with seasonal forest leaves.
